text: Augustus III bought Correggio's *Adoration of the Shepherds*, known as *La Notte* (The Night), in 1746, from the Ducal collection in Modena, and it now hangs in the Gemäldegalerie Alte Meister in Dresden. The team note says he bought the *Magdalen in the Desert* that year instead, but I can't verify that and it doesn't match my understanding of the 1746 purchase. CONFIDENCE: 80
